# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_FADE_AT_VWAP_EXTREME

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
When the price deviates significantly from VWAP (beyond 1.5 ATR) and the EMA ribbon is flat or opposing, expect a mean reversion to VWAP. This captures exhaustion moves where price extends too far from fair value while momentum (ribbon) fails to confirm, creating a countertrend opportunity.

## Mechanism
Entry rule: Let deviation = (close - VWAP) / ATR_10 (10-period ATR). If ABS(deviation) > 1.5 and the ribbon (8,13,21 EMA) is flat (all EMAs within 0.1% of each) OR the ribbon is sloping opposite to the deviation (e.g., price above VWAP but ribbon sloping down), enter in the direction of reversion (short if above VWAP, long if below) at the close of the bar.  
Exit shape: Stop at the point where ribbon confirms opposite direction (e.g., for short, if ribbon turns up and price closes above 8 EMA), TP at 1.0R.  
Regime hint: Works best in choppy, low-trend environments (ADX < 20) and midday hours (10:30-14:00 ET); avoid strong trending days.
